label: Nueva Andalucía · Marbella
title:
The Private
Resort
subtitle: A residence designed for the art of living outdoors.
intro: Villa Casia is a sequence of outdoor rituals: arrival, water, gathering, retreat and the slow transition from afternoon light to evening.
experiences: The first room is outside: landscape, shade and distance from the world.
A day organised around reflection, movement and the temperature of the light.
A residence built for gathering — without giving up privacy.
conciergeIntro: I am the private digital advisor for Villa Casia. Ask me about the residence, its spaces or Nueva Andalucía.
sequences: The day begins outdoors. Garden, shade and the first reflection in the water become part of the morning ritual.
The social heart of the house opens: kitchen, living spaces and the exterior become one continuous place.
The water catches the last light. The villa shifts from a home into a private world for the evening.
The noise falls away. What remains is privacy, warmth and the feeling of having nowhere else to be.

en: The private retreat is protected from the social rhythm of the house.
The social heart connects kitchen, dining and outdoor life.
The landscape is not a background; it is the largest room.
es: El retiro privado queda protegido del ritmo social de la casa.
El corazón social conecta cocina, comedor y vida exterior.
El paisaje no es un fondo: es la estancia más grande.

dna.title: The Private Resort
dna.intro: A residence shaped by outdoor life, water and gathering — with enough privacy to make the entire property feel like a world of its own.

note.en: The first room has no ceiling. The day begins in the garden and ends beside the water; the house is where you go to sleep.
note.es: La primera estancia no tiene techo. El día empieza en el jardín y termina junto al agua; la casa es donde vas a dormir.

note.en: No neighbours to greet, no windows to close. The property does not sit within a landscape — it contains one.
note.es: Ningún vecino al que saludar, ninguna ventana que cerrar. La propiedad no está dentro de un paisaje: contiene uno.

note.en: Twelve for lunch that become six for dinner and two at midnight. The house absorbs every version of the day without ever feeling emptied.
note.es: Doce para comer que se convierten en seis para cenar y dos a medianoche. La casa absorbe cada versión del día sin llegar a sentirse vacía.

note.en: Spa, water, shade, and the particular silence of the Golf Valley at seven in the morning. Recovery here is architectural, not scheduled.
note.es: Spa, agua, sombra y el silencio particular del Valle del Golf a las siete de la mañana. Aquí el descanso es arquitectónico, no una cita en la agenda.

note.en: La Concha on one side, the sea on the other, and between them a garden that answers to no one. The view is not a feature — it is the reason for the floor plan.
note.es: La Concha a un lado, el mar al otro, y entre ambos un jardín que no rinde cuentas a nadie. La vista no es una característica: es la razón del plano.

identityNote.en: The experience begins before the front door — in the relationship between landscape, water and the life of the house.
identityNote.es: La experiencia comienza antes de la puerta — en la relación entre el paisaje, el agua y la vida de la casa.

sequenceTitle.es: Un día formado por el agua.

sequenceIntro.en: Villa Casia is not a collection of amenities. It is a rhythm of light, water, gathering and retreat.
sequenceIntro.es: Villa Casia no es una colección de amenidades. Es un ritmo de luz, agua, reunión y retiro.

spatialTitle.es: Una casa organizada alrededor de vivir.

spatialIntro.en: The property is understood through its relationships: private retreat, social heart and open landscape.
spatialIntro.es: La propiedad se entiende a través de sus relaciones: retiro privado, corazón social y paisaje abierto.

spatialDetail.en: The house moves from private retreat to social heart and then dissolves into the open landscape.
spatialDetail.es: La casa pasa del retiro privado al corazón social y después se disuelve en el paisaje abierto.

detailsIntro.en: A home where the exterior is not an amenity, but a central part of daily life.
detailsIntro.es: Un hogar donde el exterior no es una amenidad, sino una parte central de la vida cotidiana.

en: The first room at Villa Casia is outside.
The experience begins in the garden, before the threshold.
The day is shaped by light, water and movement.
A home that turns the outdoors into a way of living.
Now you can explore how it lives.
es: El primer espacio de Villa Casia está fuera.
La experiencia comienza en el jardín, antes de cruzar el umbral.
El día se organiza alrededor de la luz, el agua y el movimiento.
Una casa que convierte el exterior en una forma de vida.
Ahora puedes explorar cómo se vive aquí.
